capabilities_time_line: - Time: `floating_timestamp` and `calendar_date` values have no timezone. `source.now_local` is the current wall-clock time in the portal's calendar zone (`source.portal.timezone`); it is absent, and `now_local_reason` (`multi_zone` or `unknown`) says why, when the portal has no single known zone. `source.now_weekday` is today's weekday in the portal's zone, present exactly when `now_local` is. A `time_semantics` entry has a `timezone` only from a reviewed claim that is not stale. `data_coverage` can lag `updated_at` by weeks.
capabilities_weekday_rule: - Name a weekday only from the data (`date_extract_dow` on the date column, 0 = Sunday) or, for today, from `source.now_weekday`; never work a weekday out yourself.
